newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Oct coffee exports end at 1.89 mln bags.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Oct coffee exports end at 1.89 mln bags.

text.p: Brazil exported 1.89 million 60-kg bags of coffee, ground and in beans, in October, the highest monthly total since September 1993, the Brazilian Federation of Coffee Exporters (FEBEC) said.
The October figure is well above the 1.15 million bags shipped in September and is also almost twice the 988,619 bags exported in the same month last year.

FEBEC president Oswaldo Aranha attributed the record exports to sales transferred over from September following the delay in lifting the ICMS state export tax, a shortage of coffee in the international market and intense sales of the harvest this year.
"In the last two months of the year, Brazilian coffee will continue very competitive in the international market," Aranha said in the FEBEC statement.
Export receipts in October were $234.94 million, well up from $141.06 million in the previous month and also from the $150.43 million raised in October 1995.
The average price per bag in October was $124.13, down from $152.16 in October 1995 but up from $122.73 in September 1996.
Of October's total, 1.815 million bags were arabica coffee, while shipments of conillon reached 77,000 bags.
Total shipments this year are now 9.54 million bags against 10.35 million bags exported in the first 10 months of 1995.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
